items.title: Royal Caribbean (NYSE:RCL) Posts Q2 CY2026 Sales In Line With Estimates
items.summary: Cruise vacation company Royal Caribbean (NYSE:RCL) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 6.5% year on year to $4.83 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $4.21 per share was 5.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
